name: bedrock-bench
description: Benchmark agents on real tasks and explore success, time, cost, and per-attempt evidence in interactive reports.

Compare verified outcomes, time, token usage, and cost in interactive reports. Select failed attempts to inspect saved evidence or ask a follow-up question, with pricing provenance retained.
